title: K6WP StudioSettings
description: Studio-side preferences for the K6WP wallpaper app. Stored at %LOCALAPPDATA%/K6WP/studio_settings.json. Deliberately separate from config.json, which is pure Engine playback state (video_path/fit/monitor/speed/fps/battery). Version 0 (legacy: missing version or missing fields) is migrated to version 3 by the loader; version 1 migrates with compress_advanced_visible defaulted to false; version 2 migrates with the removed keep_original/start_minimized keys ignored. On migration (or corrupt input) the loader backs up the original bytes to <file>.bak and rewrites the file at the current version.

version.description: Schema version. 0 = legacy (missing fields are defaulted on load), 1 = lockscreen sync fields, 2 = compressor advanced-box visibility, 3 = current (dead keep_original/start_minimized keys removed; old files carrying them migrate by ignoring those keys).

auto_compress_on_import.description: When true, importing a video into the Studio library compresses it automatically with the defaults below.

compress_output_dir.description: Directory for compressed wallpapers. Default %LOCALAPPDATA%/K6WP/wallpapers. Must not be empty.

default_crf.description: Default compression CRF for the compressor. Agrees with the engine/compressor CRF 22 default. Values outside 16-28 are rejected.

default_fps.description: Default compression target framerate. Values outside 1-30 are rejected.

default_resolution_mode.description: Default compression resolution. match_monitor = scale to the target monitor's native resolution; source = keep the input resolution; otherwise cap the long edge at the given height.

start_with_windows.description: When true, Studio registers the HKCU Run autostart entry (engine tray-only start).

cache_dir.description: Compressor cache directory. Default %LOCALAPPDATA%/K6WP/cache. Must not be empty.

lockscreen_sync.description: Bagian B: when true, engine/studio extract a static frame via compressor --lockframe on every video change (debounced, below-normal, fire-and-forget) into %PROGRAMDATA%/K6WP/lockscreen.jpg; the launcher applies it via K6WP.exe --elevate-lockscreen on|off (one-time admin for folder ACL + HKLM LockScreenImage policy).

lockscreen_offset_sec.description: Seek offset in seconds for the lockscreen frame extract. Must be >= 0.

compress_advanced_visible.description: Compressor tab advanced-box expanded state (session UI only; v1 files migrate it to false).

check_updates.description: Optional 'new version available' check (Studio-only, never downloads/installs). When true, Studio GETs the releases API once per start plus manual Help -> Check for updates; network failures are silent. Files missing this key migrate it to true.
